message.content:
I'm about to add accounting/journal integration to the 'tiket' (ticket venue) business type in KasirKu (Next.js + Supabase app at G:\PROJECT1\KasirKu). Right now ticket sales never post to the double-entry journal at all — I need to change that, mirroring how the existing fnb/retail `checkout_transaction` and `void_transaction` Postgres functions post journal entries via `private.post_journal()`.

This is READ-ONLY research — don't edit anything. I need precise, complete answers so I can write the migration myself with full context. Please investigate and report back:

1. **The exact current `checkout_ticket_transaction` (or equivalently named) RPC and `void_ticket_transaction` RPC**: find them (likely in `supabase/migrations/20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql` and `supabase/migrations/20260707100000_ticket_checkin.sql` or similar), and quote their FULL current SQL body verbatim. I need to know every column they read/write, what parameters they take, and exactly how they currently commit a ticket sale (inserting into `ticket_transactions` + related tables) and how void currently works, so I can extend them precisely without breaking anything.

2. **The `private.post_journal()` helper and `post_journal_entry` RPC** used by fnb/retail's `checkout_transaction`: quote their full SQL. I need the exact call signature/shape of journal lines it expects (array of accounts/debit/credit, etc).

3. **How `checkout_transaction` (fnb/retail) currently builds and calls `private.post_journal()`** for a sale — quote the relevant SQL block verbatim, including how it handles PPN/tax splitting (since [[mini-erp-scope]] memory notes PPN is booked as a liability, not revenue) and how it conditionally includes HPP/Persediaan lines only when cost data exists. I want to mirror the exact same pattern/conventions for tickets.

4. **Current Chart of Accounts (COA) seeding**: find `seed_default_accounts` (or whatever seeds `public.accounts` per business) and quote it fully. Does every business type (including tiket) get the exact same seeded accounts? Is there anything ticket-specific already, or would a new "Pendapatan Tiket" revenue account need to be added? What account currently exists for "Kas & Bank" (I believe it's `1-001`) and any PPN/tax liability account (`2-200` per memory)?

5. **Does `ticket_transactions` support PPN/tax at all** (check `ticket_categories`/`ticket_transactions` schema and the checkout RPC for any tax_amount/service_amount columns)? Or is ticket pricing tax-free/flat? This determines whether I need a PPN split like checkout_transaction does, or a simpler single Pendapatan-only entry.

6. **Cost basis for tickets**: is there ANY concept of a "cost" per ticket category (e.g., cost of running the attraction) that would need an HPP-style journal line, or is ticket revenue pure margin with no COGS line needed (i.e., journal is just debit Kas & Bank / credit Pendapatan, two lines, full stop)?

Quote SQL verbatim wherever you can — I'll be writing a new migration file based directly on your quotes, so precision matters far more than summarization. Organize your report by the 6 numbered questions above. This can be a longer, detailed report since I need to work directly from it — don't worry about brevity here, prioritize completeness and exact quotes.

170	-- checkout_ticket_transaction RPC -----------------------------------------
171	-- p_items: array of {ticket_category_id, qty}. Hari libur dihitung DI DALAM
172	-- RPC (bukan dipercaya dari client) supaya tidak bisa dipalsukan dan tetap
173	-- benar walau tanggal lokal di browser meleset.
174	
175	create or replace function public.checkout_ticket_transaction(
176	  p_business_id uuid,
177	  p_cashier_id uuid,
178	  p_items jsonb, -- array of {ticket_category_id, qty}
179	  p_payment_method text,
180	  p_received numeric default null,
181	  p_member_id uuid default null
182	)
183	returns table (transaction_id uuid, invoice_number text)
184	language plpgsql
185	security definer
186	set search_path = ''
187	as $$
188	declare
189	  v_business record;
190	  v_member record;
191	  v_invoice_number text;
192	  v_seq int;
193	  v_is_holiday boolean;
194	  v_subtotal numeric(12, 2) := 0;
195	  v_service numeric(12, 2) := 0;
196	  v_tax numeric(12, 2) := 0;
197	  v_total numeric(12, 2);
198	  v_change numeric(12, 2);
199	  v_transaction_id uuid;
200	  v_shift_id uuid;
201	  v_item jsonb;
202	  v_category_id uuid;
203	  v_category record;
204	  v_qty int;
205	  v_use_member_price boolean := false;
206	  v_unit_price numeric(12, 2);
207	  v_serial int;
208	  i int;
209	begin
210	  if not private.owns_business(p_business_id) then
211	    raise exception 'not authorized';
212	  end if;
213	
214	  if not exists (
215	    select 1 from public.cashiers c
216	    where c.id = p_cashier_id and c.business_id = p_business_id and c.active
217	  ) then
218	    raise exception 'invalid cashier';
219	  end if;
220	
221	  if p_payment_method is null or length(trim(p_payment_method)) = 0 then
222	    raise exception 'payment method required';
223	  end if;
224	
225	  if p_items is null or jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 then
226	    raise exception 'cart is empty';
227	  end if;
228	
229	  select b.tax_enabled, b.tax_rate, b.service_enabled, b.service_rate
230	  into v_business
231	  from public.businesses b
232	  where b.id = p_business_id;
233	
234	  select id into v_shift_id
235	  from public.shifts
236	  where business_id = p_business_id and closed_at is null
237	  limit 1;
238	
239	  if v_shift_id is null then
240	    raise exception 'no active shift — open a shift before selling';
241	  end if;
242	
243	  if p_member_id is not null then
244	    select m.id, m.valid_from, m.valid_until
245	    into v_member
246	    from public.members m
247	    where m.id = p_member_id
248	      and m.business_id = p_business_id
249	      and m.deleted_at is null;
250	
251	    if not found then
252	      raise exception 'member not found';
253	    end if;
254	
255	    if current_date < v_member.valid_from or current_date > v_member.valid_until then
256	      raise exception 'membership tidak aktif (kadaluarsa atau belum berlaku)';
257	    end if;
258	
259	    v_use_member_price := true;
260	  end if;
261	
262	  v_is_holiday := extract(dow from current_date) in (0, 6)
263	    or exists (
264	      select 1 from public.ticket_holidays h
265	      where h.business_id = p_business_id and h.holiday_date = current_date
266	    );
267	
268	  select count(*) + 1 into v_seq
269	  from public.ticket_transactions t
270	  where t.business_id = p_business_id
271	    and t.date::date = current_date;
272	
273	  v_invoice_number := 'TIX-' || to_char(current_date, 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || lpad(v_seq::text, 4, '0');
274	
275	  insert into public.ticket_transactions (
276	    business_id, shift_id, cashier_id, member_id, invoice_number, date,
277	    is_holiday, subtotal, service, tax, total, payment_method, received, change
278	  ) values (
279	    p_business_id, v_shift_id, p_cashier_id, p_member_id, v_invoice_number, now(),
280	    v_is_holiday, 0, 0, 0, 0, p_payment_method, p_received, 0
281	  )
282	  returning id into v_transaction_id;
283	
284	  for v_item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_items)
285	  loop
286	    v_category_id := (v_item ->> 'ticket_category_id')::uuid;
287	    v_qty := (v_item ->> 'qty')::int;
288	
289	    if v_qty is null or v_qty <= 0 then
290	      raise exception 'invalid quantity';
291	    end if;
292	
293	    select * into v_category
294	    from public.ticket_categories
295	    where id = v_category_id
296	      and business_id = p_business_id
297	      and deleted_at is null
298	    for update;
299	
300	    if not found then
301	      raise exception 'ticket category not found: %', v_category_id;
302	    end if;
303	
304	    v_unit_price := case
305	      when v_use_member_price then v_category.member_price
306	      when v_is_holiday then v_category.price_holiday
307	      else v_category.price_weekday
308	    end;
309	
310	    for i in 1..v_qty loop
311	      v_serial := v_category.next_serial;
312	
313	      insert into public.ticket_serials (
314	        ticket_transaction_id, ticket_category_id, business_id,

139	-- Mechanical double-entry helper — inserts a balanced entry + its lines.
140	-- Callers (security-definer RPCs) are responsible for auth/ownership checks;
141	-- this function trusts p_business_id and only enforces that debits = credits.
142	create or replace function private.post_journal(
143	  p_business_id uuid,
144	  p_date timestamptz,
145	  p_description text,
146	  p_source text,
147	  p_source_id uuid,
148	  p_lines jsonb -- array of {account_code, debit, credit}
149	)
150	returns uuid
151	language plpgsql
152	set search_path = ''
153	as $$
154	declare
155	  v_entry_id uuid;
156	  v_line jsonb;
157	  v_account_id uuid;
158	  v_total_debit numeric(14, 2) := 0;
159	  v_total_credit numeric(14, 2) := 0;
160	  v_debit numeric(14, 2);
161	  v_credit numeric(14, 2);
162	begin
163	  if p_lines is null or jsonb_array_length(p_lines) < 2 then
164	    raise exception 'journal entry needs at least 2 lines';
165	  end if;
166	
167	  for v_line in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) loop
168	    v_debit := coalesce((v_line ->> 'debit')::numeric, 0);
169	    v_credit := coalesce((v_line ->> 'credit')::numeric, 0);
170	    v_total_debit := v_total_debit + v_debit;
171	    v_total_credit := v_total_credit + v_credit;
172	  end loop;
173	
174	  if round(v_total_debit, 2) <> round(v_total_credit, 2) then
175	    raise exception 'unbalanced journal entry: debit % <> credit %', v_total_debit, v_total_credit;
176	  end if;
177	
178	  insert into public.journal_entries (business_id, date, description, source, source_id)
179	  values (p_business_id, p_date, p_description, p_source, p_source_id)
180	  returning id into v_entry_id;
181	
182	  for v_line in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_lines) loop
183	    select id into v_account_id
184	    from public.accounts
185	    where business_id = p_business_id and code = (v_line ->> 'account_code');
186	
187	    if v_account_id is null then
188	      raise exception 'account not found: %', (v_line ->> 'account_code');
189	    end if;
190	
191	    insert into public.journal_lines (entry_id, account_id, debit, credit)
192	    values (
193	      v_entry_id,
194	      v_account_id,
195	      coalesce((v_line ->> 'debit')::numeric, 0),
196	      coalesce((v_line ->> 'credit')::numeric, 0)
197	    );
198	  end loop;
199	
200	  return v_entry_id;
201	end;
202	$$;
